_pipeline: PINN simulation via results/PD_vs_time/PD_time.py for 0.01 s, then a single-time PINN/DEM/FEM comparison plot.
_pinn_model_note: Default: checkpoints in the repository root PINN/ folder (same as PD_time.load_physical_unified_model). Optional key "pinn_model_base_path" may point to another directory (e.g. PINN/freq_10k) for advanced use; omit it or set null to use PINN/ only.
